name: photo-tools
description: Photo-based travel journal posters with handmade rubber stamp artwork.

interface.shortDescription: Turn travel photos into rubber stamp journal posters.
interface.longDescription: Create one independent 4:3 travel journal poster per source photo, pairing the photograph with a small handmade rubber stamp on aged paper. Uses Codex image generation with source preservation and visual checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rubber-stamp-travel-poster to turn each uploaded photo into its own travel journal poster.
